quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. You should slow down, avoid sudden braking or direction changes, and keep more distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Then you may go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and check for vehicles or pedestrians before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a steep hill coming up. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings it upward to signal riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic lights?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns that there is low clearance coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Prepare to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means you are turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that people may be crossing the road.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, all riders should come to a stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed listed on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs require you to stop at an intersection and yield to other traffic. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out, it means the rider:
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when they do not have turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are important when riding in groups. This hand signal means "follow me."

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane. Be ready to merge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at exactly this speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed for that road. When it rains, snows, or roads are icy, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that turning left does not give you the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is one-way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car at a time can use the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the bridge ahead is narrow. Be careful when meeting or passing trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a one-way sign. Traffic flows only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right, then left.
The road curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) tells drivers the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass safely. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows the road curves sharply to the left. You may see multiple chevron signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you come to the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is under construction.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign warns you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive on the side the arrow points to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can turn right or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you of curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid blocking traffic.
Move to another lane if safe to let traffic in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane if safe to let traffic in.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room if you can. Move to another lane if it is safe and no one is driving next to you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to all pedestrians. Be alert and ready to stop when you see children near a school crossing.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are trying to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can go if the way is clear.
You must stop completely before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are trying to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. This is dangerous because you may have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulatory sign with a red circle and red slash means the action is prohibited. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A worker is directing traffic ahead.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet because vehicles are harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging into this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging into this lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic from the right will merge into your lane. Prepare to let other traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to other traffic.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead and another road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this example).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the side road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let other cars and pedestrians go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign indicates:

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for exiting a highway.
The safest speed for entering a highway.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for exiting a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger up?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger up, all riders should line up one behind the other.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Cars in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: From the center lane, which maneuver(s) can you perform?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals to show their intentions. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means the rider will turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign is white and rectangular with black letters. Drivers must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. This sign means passing other cars is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider holds their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, the group should slow down.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. A flagger is controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Wait for the intersection to clear before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals. If you extend your left arm straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride next to traffic. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway as an exit ramp. If you are in this lane, you can change to another lane to continue through, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that you will soon reach a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road on a steep slope. Low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.
